text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Osaka Hai—the race I 
had set my sights on, anticipating Silence 
Suzuka would enter.

However, the one who mattered most, 
Silence Suzuka, had opted out of the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka may not be here, but this Osaka 
Hai is not a race where I can afford to 
slack off.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will tackle this race with everything I 
have, and apply the results to my next 
battle against Suzuka."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the "Empress"— she will show us a run 
worthy of that title.
